findings.body: When the story worktree is absent, `where` can be a task checkout or task ref. This fallback then reads that task's copied plan and notes, even when the story branch contains a newer plan requiring another read. Both views can consequently report `plan_read: passed` against an outdated snapshot. `_read` at board.py:540–543 reads exactly the supplied location; the existing command logic at nextstep.py:378–384 instead consults the story branch when its worktree is absent. Resolve both plan and notes from the story's current location before falling back to the landed copy, and cover this through the commands. The current plan test retains the story worktree throughout.

findings.body: A valid configuration without the reader's `models.grill` entry runs the cold read using the provider's settings: worker.py:245–251 returns no Claude flags, and codex.py:153–155 likewise supplies no model overrides. Here the Claude run records null model and effort; the Codex sibling at codex.py:323–324 does the same. Neither reader path subsequently publishes the effective selection, so both machine views lack these required fields throughout such reads. Publish the effective provider settings and add missing-configuration reader cases. The new reader tests always configure model and effort, while the default-selection tests cover reviewers only.
